# SOPS-encrypted environment file. Placeholder until the first secret is set.
#
# This file is safe to commit — that is the point. Values are encrypted to
# this environment's age recipient (see .sops.yaml), so the repo carries the
# ciphertext and only the key opens it. Anyone who clones without the key
# reads nothing.
#
# Add a secret:
#
#   sops envs/<env>.enc.env        # opens an editor; SOPS encrypts on save
#
# Read one back:
#
#   sops -d envs/<env>.enc.env
#
# The app decrypts at boot using the SOPS_AGE_KEY the deploy supplies, so
# nothing is ever placed on the host by hand. A required secret that is
# missing fails the boot by name rather than starting half-configured.
#
# There is deliberately no plaintext .env anywhere in this project: one
# mechanism for local runs and deploys, so the two cannot drift.
